hot-poppers.name: Hot Poppers in their kraft paper bowl
hot-poppers.traits: a kraft paper bowl of popcorn chicken; each piece a round, puffy, irregular lump of boneless chicken about the size of a walnut, never square, boxy or flat-sided, no spiky flakes; deep amber-red; completely coated in a thick, wet, glossy sticky glaze; no crumbs, flakes or drops round them; lit from the front, no glowing or see-through edges.
hot-poppers.source: his own photo; traits from the 9 Nov 2026 status ad, where the leaping pieces first came out square and glowing (docs/ads/gen/chicken-munch-status/gen.py)
